title: Q-SHAPE-state-out-of-git: move queue items, ledgers and evidence out of the code repository
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation reposhape --probe state
**Status:** closed

REPO-SHAPE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-26): state is 32.7% of the tracked files (1,489 of 4,548: docs/issues 1,282 queue items, ops ledgers, outreach/packets) and 48 of the last 52 commits are bot commits to it, so the code repository's history is moved by its own loops. Move each state area to where a loop already writes it: queue items to D1 `items` (the tick Worker's system of record) with a read-only export on the evidence branch, ledgers and packets to the evidence branches and the AUDIT R2 bucket. One area per PR, in this order: docs/issues, outreach/packets, ops. A consumer (foundation/queue.py, the executor, the dashboard) reads the new home before the files leave `main`; the files are archived to `refs/archive/` first and nothing is deleted without a verified copy (AUTO-SHIP-CLEAN-1). doctrine/repo-shape.json sets each area's mode to moved only when the consumer has run from the new home for 24 h.

size: L
**Out of scope:** the full specification (DISCLOSE-1 holds it), tenant repositories, deleting any history.

Prediction: repo_shape_state_share <= 0.25 within 336 h

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation reposhape --probe state exits 0 and `python3 -m foundation reposhape --check` passes.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T18:52:12Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
